summary: The live swarm is producing useful PRs faster than main absorbs them. V2.2 completion mode is active: four family REVIEW queues intentionally trigger the existing review-backlog throttle, so fresh Go workers should prefer exact-head review, reconciliation, CI repair, and integration over creating more primary implementation branches until those queues drain.
evidence: The prior live board showed many active PR-bearing claims while reviewBacklog remained too low because implementation lanes stayed READY after opening PRs.
The four family completion lanes are now authoritative REVIEW-state queues at priority 10000.
Under the current V2.1 scheduler, four REVIEW lanes meet reviewBacklogThrottle=4 and suppress new normal primary recommendations without changing product unlocks or Studio evidence truth.
